Store fixed, L2-normalized TF-IDF rows as float32 CSR. Construct each training position’s pool from its causal recent prefix, excluding padding and the prediction target. Proposed implementation: sparse history-weight matrix H times item-feature matrix X, then row normalization; score only sampled positives/negatives using sparse row intersections or bounded dense minibatch buffers. For full-catalog recommendations, multiply normalized pools against catalog blocks and maintain running top-k, masking seen items. Never construct X Xᵀ; even sparse pairwise output can become large. PyTorch supports COO/CSR sparse multiplication, but sparse×sparse backward is unsupported; fixed pooling needs no backward, whereas learned history weights require a differentiable implementation. [PyTorch sparse.mm](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.sparse.mm)

For exact alpha=0 with useful gradients, use a directly optimized scalar initialized at zero, then project into [0,A] after every optimizer step under no_grad. Its loss derivative is confidence × cosine similarity, so beneficial updates can leave zero. Forward clamp is another option, but gradients vanish outside its interval. Smooth bounded nonnegative mappings cannot attain zero at a finite unconstrained parameter with nonzero derivative: zero is a minimum. Consequently squared/tanh-squared mappings stall at zero; sigmoid and softplus-based bounded mappings permit only approximately zero initialization, with potentially tiny gradients. At alpha=0, any parameters exclusive to the multiplied content branch initially receive zero gradient. These are mathematical implementation implications; [Softplus documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.modules.activation.Softplus.html) defines its strictly positive mapping.

For c>0, normalize(c·pool)=normalize(pool): confidence applied before cosine normalization cancels. Apply confidence afterward: ID_logit + alpha·c·dot(normalized_pool, normalized_candidate). Explicitly return zero content contribution for empty pools. [TF-IDF normalization](https://scikit-learn.org/1.7/modules/generated/sklearn.feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer.html) makes normalized dot products cosine similarities.
